inputs:footprints/api-2026-10-20.title: Footprints: complete harvest of the API (2026-10-19/20)
inputs:footprints/api-2026-10-20.description: Every list endpoint of the Footprints API (writtenwork, imprint, book = copy, footprint, person, place, actor, role, language, identifiertype, digitalformat), harvested 2026-10-19 by generators/footprints/harvest.py (one request per second, the framework's User-Agent), and the records that other records refer to but the paging missed, fetched one by one until 2026-10-20 (--fill; the API throttled, harvest_driver.py restarted it). pages.tar.gz: the pages (pages/<endpoint>/<page>.json) and the single records (fill/<endpoint>/<id>.json) as the API sent them; <endpoint>.jsonl.gz: the records by id, each once (assembled from both); harvest.json: per endpoint the count the API reported, the distinct ids, the pages and the records filled.
inputs:footprints/api-2026-10-20.note: Not published: the raw answers of the API, with the names of Footprints' editors (created_by, last_modified_by), which the dataset leaves out.

inputs:footprints/geonames-2026-10-26.title: Footprints: GeoNames ids of the places, confirmed by the API (2026-10-25/26)
inputs:footprints/geonames-2026-10-26.description: The GeoNames ids of the 1,027 places of inputs:footprints/api-2026-10-20, made by generators/footprints/geonames.py: candidates from inputs:geonames/dump-2026-10-15 (allCountries.zip) within 30 km of the place's coordinates, each asked at the API's altname endpoint (geonameId=<id>); a candidate whose answer names the place is confirmed. places.tsv: place id, canonical name, GeoNames id or empty, how (confirmed 983, not confirmed 16, no candidate 28), the candidates tried with their distances. altname.tar.gz: the answers as the API sent them (altname/<geonames id>.json, 1,003).
inputs:footprints/geonames-2026-10-26.note: Not published: the raw answers of the API.

notes: 3,765 works, 6,860 imprints, 10,998 copies, 24,482 footprints, 11,642 persons (1,556 with VIAF), 1,027 places (983 with GeoNames), 24,734 actor records. IRIs of 2024 replaced: 8,713 persons, 2,185 works, 120 places.
